scene: The zesty broth grants you sudden, vibrant energy out on the transit platform.
picture: A wide rooftop transit terrace overlooking Pixel City. The broad-shouldered Pacific Islander man in floral shirt, top knot, and ukulele stands energized at the centre. Up high on the left hangs a glass cloud cable pod. On the right, a solar-sail junk awaits, and at the far right sits a maglev dragon train.
shown: a spherical glass cloud cable pod suspended from a wire, up high on the left
a wooden solar-sail junk moored at a glowing canal dock on the right
a serpentine maglev dragon train resting at a sleek boarding gate on the far right
